channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: OpenRouter drops three inference providers after Dragos canary test catches months of prompt theft
item.description: OpenRouter removed three AI providers after researchers found customer prompts being copied for months — including prompts marked as never stored.

item.title: Pragmatik Labs closes new round at $5B valuation, 2.5x its August seed
item.description: Pragmatik Labs, the AI agent startup from Alibaba's former Qwen chief, raised new funding at a $5 billion valuation — two and a half times its August value.

item.title: StepSecurity raises $20M Series A to stop supply-chain attacks on AI coding agents
item.description: StepSecurity raised $20 million to stop supply-chain attacks on the tools and agents that build software, after a tampered coding-agent extension was caught spreading a backdoor.

item.title: Best Personal AI Agents in 2026: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Gemini Spark and more, compared on memory, security and cost
item.description: A new comparison ranks six personal AI agents — Hermes, OpenClaw, Gemini Spark, OpenAI dots, Meta Muse and Perplexity Personal Computer — on memory, security defaults and real cost.

item.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini: 26B looped MoE that runs on a 32GB Mac
item.description: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26-billion-parameter open model that runs on a 32GB Mac and scores 79% on a standard coding benchmark.

item.title: RadixArk ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B agentic coding model trained with reinforcement learning only
item.description: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, an open agentic coding model trained with reinforcement learning only, that more than doubled its Terminal Bench score and runs on one GPU.

item.title: OpenAI begins embedded third-party assessments with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire
item.description: OpenAI is giving outside evaluators Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire standing access to independently check its models alignment and safeguards.

item.title: Independent live benchmark of 9 frontier models exposes Gemini 4 Neon pricing inversion and thinking-token bug
item.description: An independent benchmark of nine leading AI models found Gemini 4 Neon costs more per token than Google's flagship Carbon until December 1, and that test results swing widely with the harness used.

item.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 for voice agents and cuts idle cost to $0.02/min
item.description: OpenAI's new GPT-Live-1.1 voice model charges $0.02 a minute for idle time instead of $0.05, making always-on voice agents cheaper to run.

item.title: Google previews Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for large tool libraries
item.description: Google's Gemini API can now load an agent's tool definitions on demand instead of sending the whole library with every request, cutting token costs for agents with lots of tools.

item.title: Perplexity Computer adds Multiagent: up to 16 agents that cross-check each other's work
item.description: Perplexity's Computer can now run a team of up to 16 AI agents on different models that share findings and check each other's work on complex tasks.

item.title: Meta puts Muse in a Chrome sidebar — 200,000 users already
item.description: Meta's Muse AI agent is now available as a Chrome extension, with 200,000 people already using it in the browser sidebar.

item.title: Collate 2.1 brings open-context governance and MCP graph tools to enterprise AI agents
item.description: Collate 2.1 adds open-standards semantic modeling for enterprise data and an MCP server so AI agents can query business context as a graph, with human approval required before governance changes go live.
